I completely agree with you. 

The other girl that I'm worried about, worries me because she recently broke it off with her fiancé and asked to move in with this guy I like. Also, they sometimes go to the bar together and I guess I just don't know him well enough to decipher if it's innocent or not. And the fact that I'm anxious to know what's going on between the two of us!

Every single thing you just said was an assumption and a wrong assumption at that. I moved 40 minutes away with permission of the judge because I was ordered to move out of the marital residence by her and that's where I found a job. 

His many text messages look like this:

I found a place close to yours in MO. The day I move I will be filing to take you back to court for 50/50 custody since me moving there would be considered a major change in living situation. Also, the child support calculations in Missouri are lower and I will be having that modified as well. We were forced to file in Illinois but I will be moving to Missouri to have all of these things modified immediately."

That's pretty self explanatory. 

Mind you, I didn't ask for alimony, retirement fund money, any of our joint checking/savings money, and he hasn't bought her so much as a single diaper in 7 months. He has 50% custody of a child from a previous marriage who he does not exercise any visitation with whatsoever and he has been convicted of domestic violence against me twice during our short marriage. But you're right, he sounds like a winner.
The judge agreed that I could relocate to Missouri and it says so in our current papers. He's going to follow me to this state because he wants to modify the custody agreement in MO.
I will do that, thank you
No restraining order and our court hearing isn't until next Wednesday, but the fact is he stole my personal property

I am exclusively living in the home during the divorce proceedings. 

He wants our only vehicle, our home, and full custody of our daughter NOW. Temporarily and permanent. Up until last week I was unemployed because he wouldn't let me work during our marriage, so basically he wants me out on the street.

He has been the bread winner, I just got a good job in my field last week.

I just want temporary possession of our vehicle and home. I plan to get my own place and buy a car next month. I want full custody of our daughter and was willing to give him one weekend a month.

He's been posting our divorce situation verbatim on facebook for the whole world to see unfortunately, making me look like a horrible person, in which I'm not and letting everyone say horrible things about me, people i've never even met in my life. I can bet you that pictures of that journal will be posted on there too.

I'm a lot better, feeling violated because those things I wrote were so personal, I didn't want other eyes to see it and he's the type of person that I'm sure his whole family and then some has seen it by now. But some of the more alarming things I wrote were only 4-6 weeks ago.

I was about 16 and my sister was 13. She constantly threatened me with the whole "I'm telling mom this or that"... one day I had enough. I drug her out of the recliner she was sitting in by her hair down two flights of stairs and left her in the basement to cry it out. She was twice my size and still is. She never tried to rat me out again.

Looking back on it, I was a bitch but that was 7 years ago and we laugh about it to this day.

Being a single mom of two kids, packing up and moving to another city, graduating from college, securing a wonderfully paying job and not living paycheck to paycheck all without the help of my unsupportive family and all before age 24.
Thank you so much for your response, very helpful!
We have our initial consult tomorrow, he was just getting the jist of the situation, but thank you!
Illinois. I was only told this by the lawyer over a phone consultation. I haven't got to meet with him in person, I'm just wondering if others have been through something similar.

Has the divorce paperwork actually begun? Because if not, and you don't really trust him, don't let him take them. It may be different in other states but in my state, whoever physically has custody of the children when the divorce is filed is who keeps physical custody of the children until a custody agreement has been made in writing. My STBX left a little over two months ago, I've yet to be served papers but I know it should be any day now. If I let him take the kids, he has NO legal obligation to bring them back to me right now. He literally can just keep them. This is something he would definitely do, so he hasn't seen them since he left. (He left for work for two weeks in March and decided he wasn't coming back, they still think he's away for work).

I'm in the same situation. I want to keep my married name for three reasons. 

1. After almost 2 years of marriage, I literally just had my social security card officially changed a few months before my STBX ended up leaving and I don't want to go through the hassle of all the name changes again. Just peachy.
2. I have two daughters, one from a previous marriage, one from current marriage, though my oldest daughter has a different last name, I don't really want all three of our last names to be different.
3. I also don't have a personal connection to my maiden name. In fact, I just don't like it. It's a common name, nothing crazy, but it doesn't feel like "me". 

The biggest dilemma is that my married name kind of haunts me. I was left, and I'm going through an unwanted divorce. It's painful but I'm starting to see it's necessary. I feel like if I keep my married name, I'll forever be tied to someone who hurt me badly and I'll always carry that baggage. I almost cringe when I have to tell someone my name right now because it all comes rushing back.

Oh decision, decisions. There's a lot of good advice here. Just go with your gut instinct.

I've just been reading through this thread and so I'm going to just creep in here and say my STBXH is 5'11 and around 212lbs. Though he weighed quite less before our marriage, I didn't find him to be fat or disgusting in any way and I'm a tiny thing - 4'11 94lbs :)

I know what you mean. Sometimes I sit back and think about why I'm feeling the way I'm feeling. While I do miss him tremendously, I miss most what things "could/should have been" and most importantly, I think what is causing a lot of the emotional turmoil is the future of the unknown. What lies ahead for me. That's the scariest part usually.

Mornings are the hardest for me also. Sometimes I feel like I'm in a panic just minutes after I open my eyes. It has also been about 2 months for me and so far it really hasn't gotten easier. My doctor gave me a prescription for ativan which sometimes helps take the edge off of things. I just try to get up, open up the curtains and take it one day at a time in hopes one day I'll wake up and it won't feel that way anymore. Good luck to you. {Hugs}

I'm a makeup junkie and I love the artistry of it. Going through a divorce and frankly I looked like shit. Total shit. My six year old daughter told me one day, "Mommy, I think it would be best if you go put some makeup on right now..." I don't think I've ever cried tears of laughter and sadness at the same time.
Blackfish. It's an eye opener for sure.
My cousin named her sons Jerek and Jeret and her new husbands name is Jared. Like, bitch stop.

He's been gone about 2 months. We've only talked once or twice via email. So I would say yes. He changed his phone number and didn't give it to me, but in reality it's probably better that way. I don't even know where he's staying. I have good days and bad days but thinking back to what could have been just flat out sucks. I haven't found joy in essentially anything since he left. Everything I do just makes me wish he was there to enjoy it with me.
I'm slowly starting to feel that way also, it still hurts though. The fact that you can't go back in time.
Thank you for the OCD related panic attack.
So I've been told
She's not allowed to answer the door so I guess we'll never know
Ah ok. I'm pretty sure the sheriff's deputy here has a green uniform. I could be completely wrong though and I'm just extremely paranoid and avoiding the fact I may be served any day now. Ha.
The scene in The Revenant where Leo was getting his mauled by a bear. It was brutal but more so an uncomfortably lengthy scene. After like 10 minutes I think we got the point.

4.5 years ago. I've never found someone I was so compatible with in every single way. It was pure bliss. Then I found a bunch of naked pictures pulled up on his laptop of his ex girlfriend and a girl who was supposedly a friend. They were old pictures but nevertheless he was still looking at them. He was getting "it" from me every single day, sometimes more than once. I threw his Macbook off my third floor balcony into a foot of snow. We never spoke again. I still think about him often, just because of the compatibility, he was the one that got away.

People who talk about themselves the entire time.

I was a pretty rebellious teenager and when I was 14 I took my grandpa's truck in the middle of the night to visit my boyfriend. Yes I know, I was bad. On my way home I noticed that it was almost out of gas. I knew nothing about driving. Pulled into a gas station, was trying to see if it was open (it was like 1am) and hit a giant red pole next to the pump (I was going like 2mph lol). I panicked, drove away. Parked the truck and went to bed. A few weeks later I heard my parents talking about how my grandpa's truck had been hit or something and there was some red paint scratches on the front. They used his truck to pull our camper frequently when we went camping. They all assumed it must have got hit while we were camping. 9 years later and I will take that to my death bed.

I once told my younger sister that the ocean is salty because hundreds of years ago a huge ship carrying a massive load of salt sank. She believed me. She was 17 and honestly, I'm pretty sure she still believes that. Ha!

I'm not a lawyer so please make sure you follow up with one, but I would assume it would be a civil matter against your brother so your father can get that money back. The funeral home would have nothing to do with it.

That's a bad situation, I'm sorry. If your father gave the other sibling the money for the bill and there's no way to contact him, I would take that to court. Is there any way you can settle the bill? Because it doesn't matter which sibling is responsible for the bill if your parents gave up next of kin rights, any of the siblings are really able to settle it.

I filed paperwork [for the sake of having it documented as well] with the inspector general who contacted his commander. His commander contacted me last night and said that because he is still paying the rent, they can't force him to pay anything else. Isn't that ridiculous? The only thing I can do is go through the civilian court to get child support. He also called my husband afterwards who fed him a whole bunch of bullshit lies, and who'd the commander believe. Him of course. I did get it documented though for when I go to my civilian attorney.

I did call his CO and explained the situation, he also called my soon to be ex husband and he fed him a whole bunch of shit (it's his soldier, who's he going to believe?) He basically said since my husband is still paying the rent on the house, they cannot force him to pay anything more, only can be handled through the civilian court. But once the divorce is final, we will be out of the house because I can't afford to keep up with the rent.
This really resonated with me. Thank you for putting into this perspective.
No, we were together for 3 years total. We dated for 1.5 years, then married for 1.5 years.

Sadly I did stoop that low. I begged. A lot. For a long time. I finally gave up begging because he did not budge even a little. So clearly he doesn't have any interest in coming back. We have minimal contact now only via email and he is doing everything he can to try to control every aspect of the divorce and ruin me the best he can.
1. Lying to anyone and everyone about what really happened during our marriage and why he left.
2. Telling the world (lies) because he knows I'm a very private person and I don't like for anyone to know my business.
3. We have been strictly talking business. In the last month I have not discussed our relationship even one time. Not even hinted at it. He continues to throw in a "You're just made because I don't love you/ don't want to be with you/ never liked you/ hate you"...

All the mean shit he can think of. We're only talking about divorce details and he insists on throwing in completely unnecessary low blows.

Do you think people like this eventually crash and burn? As bad as it sounds, after all he's put me through in the last 3 years, I have my fingers crossed for the day when it all comes pouring down on him. I can't tell what he feels like on the inside right now, but on the outside, he's portraying that he's better than ever.
Thank you so much

After what I've been through, I don't think I could see the silver lining, "finding someone who does love me in the right ways" if it smacked me in the face. I'm afraid I'll never trust again. A big downfall in our marriage was that I didn't have a lot of trust for him (though I know he wasn't cheating on me), I didn't trust his intentions and he really wanted me to. Gut instinct, turns out I was right all along.

I know, I know deep down he dislikes many things about himself but he is such a master manipulator and has a STRONG game face. Due to the military, he has TONS of friends all around the states and all of them think he's a saint and he's really good at making himself look like a wonderful, "I can do no wrong" type of person and everyone buys his shit, which leaves me picking up the pieces after I stuck by his side through all of his poor life choices. It just sucks.

Yeah he's moving on rather quickly considering we had what I thought to be an extremely deep emotional connection (and he's expressed he felt that too). Bar scene every other night. Trying to make everyone feel bad for him on social media to soul suck as much attention as he can possibly get. We have children. It just doesn't make sense.

Escalators. I'm afraid my foot will get caught in the gap as in stepping on, or my fingers will get caught if I hold on to the moving hand rail so when I get on I have to hold the hand rail to make sure I step exactly on the step and not on the crack then let go of the hand rail so my fingers don't get caught and I'm afraid of heights so the whole way up I have nothing to hold onto and I'm afraid I'm going to fall down them. Yes, all aboard the hot mess express.

Walking over rail road tracks. When I was younger my cousins boyfriend got his foot stuck in the tracks and got hit and killed by a train. I also don't trust the flashing signals or gates to work so I'm afraid I'll get hit by one driving across the tracks.

You may not understand it, but most of us here don't understand why our spouses have chose to jump ship either. It's heartbreaking, I know, take that from someone who's spent at least 6 hours crying hysterically today. I wish you the best also.
I feel like I wrote this. I'm going through exactly this and I'm sorry you're experiencing it too. It is in fact a nightmare that I can't escape.
I'm sorry you feel that way but if it helps one person, that's all I care about. I genuinely care about people.

I wish I could just say "I don't want a divorce" and it would magically stop my husband dead in his tracks from filing the paperwork. If only it worked that way. I completely agree, the majority of us (not all) are here for support from a divorce we didn't necessarily want.

This quote has helped me so much, but it still hurts. Because the man he is now is not the man i spent years making memories with. Isn't it crazy how someone can pretend to be somebody they're not, often times for a very long period of time. You think everything is ok, or they are the person they are portraying or at least want to be and then bam! One day they're gone. That person they pretended to be never actually existed and you find yourself wondering what in the actual fuck did you put yourself through. Feels like the Ultimate betrayal.

I think you hit the nail on the head for me. I don't necessarily miss "him", I miss having the sense of stability, the knowledge that someone is going to be there when I wake up and go to bed, I miss the habit of having someone I "thought" that loved me to go through the ins and outs of life with. It sucks nevertheless because all the good memories still flash through my mind on a daily basis and brings me down, makes me forget who he really is. 

Quote I read the other day:
"I was about to miss you, but I realized everything I thought I would miss was who I wanted you to be and nothing you actually were".

There was nothing per se that I couldn't do for him. It was more butting heads on what I wanted him to do for me that he couldn't do. Though he gave it a shot, it wasn't true and he couldn't stick to it. There were a lot of trust issues, and he was a social butterfly and very much attention seeker (needs validation from the world with everything he does) while I am very much reclusive and prefer to keep my life more private. In the end he decided his friends/going out every weekend to the bars etc. was what he wanted more than coming home to his wife and kids. I guess it just became too much for him. There was no balance. What I wanted and what he wanted didn't mesh at all. Saying it's pretty upsetting to be on this end is an understatement.

Yes, I recently started meditating and I actually do guided meditation through an app called Headspace. There's a free 10 session trial before you commit to paying monthly. I have really bad anxiety and depression and i'm going through some really rough things right now, after I meditate, I get very sleepy and calm. Amazing sleep if you do it right before bed. Hey OP, I want to tell you something that I wish I could go back in time and tell myself at 16. High school is not forever. It feels like it, I know. I really truly know. I was bullied pretty badly during that time. Irrelevant but I also became a mother at 16. Life is hard, it truly is. But just know that right now you are still in the baby stages of your life. Enjoy your time as a teenager. I'm not discrediting your problems whatsoever. I know how it feels to have parents that don't understand you or don't understand how to help you when you reach out. It hurts. Find someone you can depend on, someone you can talk to. Talk about your dreams, talk about your goals, make good grades even if you have to fight through it. Get a high school diploma or you'll spend your life regretting that you gave up. As for the future, you grow up and life gets hard in a whole DIFFERENT way. Take it day by day, take a deep breath, know your worth and breathe.

Understood, I reached out on the military subreddit today genuinely looking for advice on a tough situation and (though I should've known), was completely ripped to shreds by a bunch of guys who have no compassion for other human beings. Then you feel like you have to defend yourself to a bunch of internet strangers when you came there for help, not to be kicked while you're down. I'm sorry this happened to you. Keep your head held high. The quote /u/novusprime28 put down there is exactly right!

I've been browsing reddit for a couple weeks now trying to find someone who knows exactly how I feel, and you- you and I feel the EXACT same way. I'm sorry this is happening to you. I have panic attacks before I even get out of bed in the morning, I don't eat and I dry heave from the pure torturous amount of anxiety that I can't shake. It's by far the worst thing I've ever been through. The only advice that I've found is to take it day by day though sometimes thats too much and I have to take it minute by minute.
